title: Lunchly
description: This mod adds Lunchly and other Youtuber products to Minecraft.
body: The Lunchly mod adds many items and mobs related to the Youtuber product, Lunchly. **This is a joke mod.** There are new mobs like MrBeast, KSI, Logan Paul, the Prime Bottle and more. There are new foods and even an entire Lunchly dimension.
